qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Substantial coherent native cyan/blue open portal, stable dimensional navy supports, restrained subordinate warm craftsmanship and broad soft readable volume light; clean purposeful one-shot activation in all registered views.

shapeVolume: Recognizable cyan open portal ring with paired dark blue supports and deliberate blue accent forms; the center remains genuinely open geometry around the registered entry socket.
Fuller continuous rim thickness, clear layered construction and convincing rim/support transitions; visible depth is coherent in front/back and physically edge-on side views.

Purposeful native detail improves structure and visual hierarchy. Counts, original weak torus topology and undecorated old feet are not automatic constraints. No need to match ImageGen pixels or camera-distorted proportions.
color: Cyan/aqua remains the dominant ring family; blue/navy anchors and accents stay distinct. Optional small warm metal accents are subordinate and should support target identity rather than replace it.

Navy support facets retain enough separation at logical and phone size to read as shaped material on light, gray and dark backgrounds; no broad near-black dead zones or electric flat cyan saturation bands.
lightHighlights: Soft organized highlight-to-mid-tone transitions reveal volume and bevels, with broad readable highlights rather than jagged hot outlines or blown featureless plates.

No preferred horizontal light direction across rotatable views; materials and native light may change coherently. No directional ground shadow. Do not require identical pixels in opposite views where real construction differs.
materialDetail: Ring, inset panels, support stone and any small metal trims have clear material roles with friendly cartoon finish; visible detail survives intended size.
Joins do not float, pierce through surfaces accidentally or form dark coplanar seams. Repeated detail rhythms are intentional and stable during motion.
motionAndContact: All four measured facings render the enter clip as twelve ordered frames at twelve fps, one-shot, with terminal frame held by the current consumer. No invented duplicate closure frame or forced loop is required.
Pulse and orbit read as one smooth purposeful activation; fixed feet remain stable around the same ground root. Revised decoration may move coherently without detaching from intended construction.
Registered entry socket and clear opening remain usable. The catalog's beside-submarine presentation is not proof of a docking, support or transit mechanic.
artifactFreeReadability: Inspect every required native frame/facing and current-consumer playback, plus representative start/peak/terminal views at logical and phone scale against light, gray and dark.
No clipped envelope, unintended edge alpha/halos, black patches, broken corners, accidental gaps, exposed ends, shimmering details, unwanted shadow or disappearing side-view construction.
Enforce the reconciled camera/frame/root/socket/registration and measured native budget; do not convert catalog footprint metadata into an opaque fullcell floor or unmeasured exact old mesh bounds.
